The mid-ground is dominated by tall, dense stacks of rough-sawn lumber planks arranged in rows. In the background, there are structural elements including blue steel beams and a high ceiling, consistent with an industrial warehouse environment.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the dark foreground surface appears slightly smudged or painterly, lacking the crisp mechanical detail expected of heavy industrial machinery. The sawdust distribution looks somewhat uniform rather than naturally scattered.

The edges of the individual planks in the central stack blend into each other slightly, losing distinct separation. Some plank ends appear to merge or warp, a common AI artifact in repetitive geometric structures.

The vertical lines of the background structure and the edge of the lumber stack on the far right show slight warping and inconsistency with the linear perspective established by the foreground tracks.
